name: io.github.murilojrpereira/mcp-openapi-bridge
description: Generic MCP server that bridges any OpenAPI 3.x REST API to Claude Code — auto-generates one MCP tool per endpoint from the spec.

environmentVariables.name: API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the REST API, e.g. https://api.stripe.com

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local file path to the OpenAPI spec (.json, .yaml, or .yml)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_SPEC_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL to fetch the OpenAPI spec from (cached for 1 hour)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for Authorization header. Can also be passed per-call via the bearer_token tool argument.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key value. Use with OPENAPI_API_KEY_HEADER or OPENAPI_API_KEY_PARAM.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_API_KEY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header name for API key auth, e.g. X-API-Key

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_API_KEY_PARAM
environmentVariables.description: Query parameter name for API key auth, e.g. api_key

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_CUSTOM_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Extra headers applied to every request. Format: Header-Name=value,Other-Header=value2

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_INCLUDE_TAGS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags to include. Only operations with these tags are registered as tools.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_PATH_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Only register operations whose path starts with this prefix, e.g. /v1/

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_MAX_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of tools to register (default: 128). Large specs may exceed Claude's context limit.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'http' to run the hosted HTTP transport instead of stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the HTTP server listens on when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 8080.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by the hosted /mcp HTTP endpoint when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Recommended for public-routable deployments.
